In effect, that means the burden of repairing Social Security will fall on both sitting and newly elected lawmakers. Two college students who went hiking in Colorado have been found dead after they were not seen or heard from for several days. Deputies discovered the bodies of Kaden Matsuda, 19, and Jackson Donlon, 20, in a mountain basin on West Apostle Mountain, the Chaffee County Sheriff's Office confirmed. Matsuda, of Ridgway, Colorado, and Donlon, of Queensbury, New York, were both students at Colorado Mountain College Leadville campus. Deputies say they left campus for a hike near Ice Mountain on Friday, Oct. 23.

stories.summary: MLS unveiled it's 14-match sprint schedule for all 30 teams on Thursday afternoon with some unexpected tweaks for longtime fans. The league is playing a condensed, 14-match regular season plus playoffs from the middle of February to the end of May to enable the calendar flip coming in later 2027 . The full MLS regular season will return in late July and be contested in a summer-to-spring format similar to the Premier League, La Liga and other top soccer competitions. The 2027 sprint season will provide teams a second chance to win an MLS Cup in about six months. And it features some interesting tweaks to what we're used to.

stories.summary: Is it really just a coincidence that some teams are playing three consecutive primetime games in 2026? One reason the NFL schedule release has become such an event on the football calendar each spring is the increasingly complicated nature of how it works. No longer is it simply a game on Thursday, a game on Sunday night and a game on Monday night surrounding the bulk of the slate on Sunday afternoon. Well, sometimes it is -- but, with each passing year, the NFL has found creative ways to put games in unique windows, from Sunday morning international games, to Christmas tripleheaders and even to a "Thanksgiving Eve" game this season.
